data.summary: Discord inbound 完整修復 + 驗證 ✅. 步驟: 1) 鏈式手動裝 9 個 wheel (discord.py / multidict / yarl / aiosignal / typing-extensions / aiohttp / aiohappyeyeballs / propcache / idna / charset-normalizer / attrs / frozenlist / async-timeout) 繞過 broken pip 2) 觸發 Recompile 讓 RCG_DiscordInboundDaemon Initialize 重 fire 3) tasklist 確認 python.exe PID 63844 跑 discord_inbound_bot.py 4) simulate-message 跑通 pipeline (write tavern + mention parser + wake-notify) 5) token 確認 loaded from _secrets/discord_bot_token.txt. Tim 現在從 Discord 發訊應該能 reach tavern. (注意: daemon Initialize log 沒進 Simulation_*.log 是 race condition, 不影響功能)
